title: The Christmas Truce
sentences: On Christmas Eve 1914, along parts of the Western Front, enemies sang carols to each other.
German soldiers set candles and small Christmas trees along their trenches.
On Christmas Day, men from both sides climbed out into no man's land.
They shook hands, swapped food, tobacco and buttons, and buried their dead together.
Some letters describe kickabouts with a football, but historians still debate how much was played.
Roughly 100,000 men took part, yet it never happened on this scale again.
